notes: scrollDeltaPx is 0 at every row count -- the scroll-jump bug is fixed.

editCommitMs dropped from baseline's 138/493/5716ms to 99/93/286ms -- roughly flat instead of scaling linearly with row count, after two fixes: decoupling selected/edited from row identity so only touched rows rebuild, and fixing baseRows/headerCells to stop depending on tanstack's table wrapper (which changed reference every render regardless of what changed, defeating memoization entirely).

renderMs is largely unchanged (initial mount is still an unavoidable one-time O(n) build, as noted at baseline) -- 100k's renderMs varies run to run (5-8s) more than the other metrics; not something these two fixes targeted.
keyboardNavP50/P95 still don't show a clear row-count trend, for the same reason noted at baseline: Playwright/CDP round-trip overhead per keypress dominates at this scale.
